programme.desc: Desperate to get a moose for winter, Heimo pushes into the Arctic as temperatures plummet. Charlie and Tyler look to start their trapping seasons but must overcome devastating fire damage on their traplines.

programme.title: Animal Cops Houston
programme.desc: When a dog is found hanging by her neck in a yard the SPCA tries to save her. And investigators rush to reunite some pups with their mother before it's too late.

programme.title: The Zoo
programme.desc: While a trio of rare Dhole canines prepare to make their cross-country adventure to the zoo, the keepers anxiously await their arrival; a tinamou chick must be cared for; a specialized tool is welded to extract a Babirusa's tusk.

programme.title: Pit Bulls & Parolees
programme.desc: Villalobos is invaded by a swarm of bees, forcing Tia to face the costs of having the hive removed; Mariah and Tania suggest throwing a fundraiser for the ranch.

programme.title: Project Grizzly
programme.desc: Renowned bear handler Jeff Watson sets out on an adventure to teach his two 700lb grizzly bears, Bob and Screech, how to survive on their own in the wild.

programme.title: Extinct Or Alive
programme.desc: Forrest scours lakes and rivers of both metropolitan and rural Vietnam in search of one of the last living specimens of the giant softshell turtle.

programme.title: Expedition Bigfoot
programme.desc: The team discovers evidence that could finally prove Bigfoot exists! But, uncontrolled wildfires in Washington could ruin the investigation.

programme.title: My Cat From Hell
programme.desc: Two couples need Jackson's help against their ferocious felines. Olive and Pepper cannot be left alone in fear that it will end up in a blood bath. Bengal cat, Mufasa, is high-energy and uses his owner as a personal clawing board.

programme.title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
programme.desc: When a homeless man's five-month-old puppy breaks its paw, Dr Jeff and his team put the animal's welfare ahead of everything else.

programme.desc: A washed-up wrestler is forced to retire after a heart attack. His quest for a normal life is an unrelenting struggle.
